visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Object.keys and forEach
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The keys are first collected into an array with a for...in loop and then printed with an index loop. Use Object.keys with forEach. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Object.keys returns only the object's own keys, so no hasOwnProperty check is needed, and forEach removes the extra array and the index variable.
